verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-detection SaaS/API product, not an AI-native developer tool or agent that collects usage telemetry about its own operation; the telemetry opt-out story targets AI tooling privacy posture, which is a different axis than Signifyd's core function of collecting device/order data for fraud scoring. No evidence pack item addresses telemetry opt-out settings for the product itself.
